change: Bisect failed value-test batches to attribute compilation errors, runtime panics and incomplete successful exits to individual cases. Keep failures that disappear when split.
coverage: Native/web: isolated compile failure, panic, exit(0), successful batch single-build assertion, and injected combined-only failure preservation.
limits: Additional builds occur only after a failed batch. Timeout exceptions retain the existing bounds rather than recursively repeating slow/hung builds. Hosted CI checks the full suite and parallel grouping.
